question: Does the reusable National Museum fish-specimen dataset contain text-locality records naming Caliraya, Lumot, or Lumban?

source.title: Fish Specimen Collection of National Museum, Philippines
source.provider: ASEAN Centre for Biodiversity / National Museum of the Philippines via GBIF
source.datasetDescription: The publisher describes an updated National Museum collection of common and commercial fish, with samples collected at landing sites, markets of commercial ports, and nearby seas.

screen.method: Case-insensitive literal search across every occurrence row for the strings Caliraya, Lumot, and Lumban.

limits: This is a bounded literal-text search of version 1.38, not a complete search of every National Museum catalogue record or every dataset.
The screen does not cover coordinate-only records, alternate place names, undocumented field values, or records not included in this version.
A zero-match result does not establish fish absence, lack of historical sampling, or lack of records in another collection.
No record coordinates were reviewed or retained, and no capture locality, specimen, or taxon was assessed in this screen.
The dataset license permits reuse with attribution, but does not resolve biological identity or capture origin for records whose descriptions mix landing sites, markets, ports, and nearby seas.
nextAction: Continue the Caliraya-Lumot source sweep with an independently accessible, waterbody-resolved fish survey or voucher record; keep the aggregate 2022 abstract and historical stocking/catch summaries separate from current occurrence claims.
